Emma B (Eng): FYI i'm getting a foster placement expected 2024-08-12. does Redwood cover foster placement parental leave? looking for how much paid time i can take and any quick docs we need.
Nora S (People Ops): congrats! yes we cover foster placements. policy: up to 6 weeks Redwood paid parental leave for foster placement (same as adoption). you need an official placement letter from the agency or caseworker. please submit the Parental Leave Request form and upload the placement letter.
Emma B (Eng): sweet. is there an emergency childcare / backfill stipend option for the first two weeks if we need temporary help while i transition?
Nora S (People Ops): there is a one-time emergency caregiver stipend available for placement scenarios. max $1,200 or conversion of up to 40h PTO, whichever is less. submit the "Emergency Stipend" form with dates and estimate. cc payroll.
Benefits Team: note that health/dental remain active during approved leave. stipend is taxable and may affect FSA/401k withholdings; we'll send a benefits impact note after docs are verified.
payroll-bot: form link -> https://intranet.redwood/payroll/forms/emergency-stipend. Steps:
```
1) Employee fills Emergency Stipend form (attach placement letter)
2) Manager approves in workflow
3) People Ops verifies docs
4) Payroll processes stipend on next cycle (code: EMR-STIP)
```
payroll-bot: stipend is payroll-taxable supplemental income; if converting PTO instead, use the Accrual Conversion form.
Emma B (Eng): i'm also on the on-call rotation. can i do a 6-week partial return (3 days onsite / 2 days async) and still keep leave top-up?
Alex G (Eng Manager): happy to sign off on a phased 60% schedule. Emma, DM me dates and core hours (11-3) and i'll approve in the form. please make sure on-call swaps are arranged.
Emma B (Eng): will do. i'll upload placement letter and submit both forms today. thanks y'all!
